reviewer: survey_transport_review; independent of implementation, bundles and GPU review
scope: Diagnostic structured-clone sidecar transport and exact native runtime roof ownership only; primary Oudezijds Voorburgwal 87/89 fixture, no public source admission.
decision: bounded-diagnostic-transport-contract-pass-after-three-root-repairs; actual game, visual and performance acceptance remain pending

findings.cause: Adapter admitted aggregate heights within 1e-6, but buildFeatureChunk required exact height equality. Transport advertised every validated binding with a nonzero range, including a binding rejected by the mesh builder.
findings.impact: Independent stock roof could be hidden even though the installed chunk contained only stock geometry.
findings.repair: Transport now requires exact installed aggregate height and construction year before registering a binding; source adapter tolerance remains unchanged.
findings.verification: Independent rerun of transport suite passed new byte-equal-stock and empty-ownership regression for height epsilon in walls/coarse and all three primary looks.

findings.cause: dispose increments appearanceToken but does not increment envelopeLoadToken; onRemove calls dispose.
findings.impact: A response belonging to a removed renderer can mutate its state and enqueue rebuilds using retained sourceGroups/THREE state.
findings.requestedRepair: Invalidate envelopeLoadToken in dispose and regress a successful late response after onRemove/dispose.
findings.reproductionBeforeRepair: Start pending mocked diagnostic fetch, call browser.dispose(), then resolve the fetch with the valid fixture payload. loadDiagnosticSurveyedEnvelopes returns true and transport holds one envelope after disposal.
findings.repair: dispose now increments envelopeLoadToken before invalidating jobs and removing chunks.
findings.verification: Successful mocked fetch resolving after dispose now returns false and leaves transport empty; independently rerun passing regression.

findings.cause: Ownership checks visible and installed meshes only; render also skips when zoom < MIN_ZOOM (14) or ready is false. The independent pyramid renderer has no matching zoom gate.
findings.impact: An independent roof can remain suppressed when its purported source owner is not drawn below the building layer minimum zoom.
findings.requestedRepair: Align ownership with actual renderer availability/zoom and update it on gate transitions, preserving the union with landmark suppression. Confirm an actual game zoom transition independently; this review contains no GPU evidence.
findings.reproductionBeforeRepair: A stored coarse entry with boundParentIds ['example'] and getZoom() returning 13 still publishes ['example'] through refreshSurveyedRoofOwnership, despite the building render gate skipping that scene.
findings.repair: Ownership requires visible, ready and zoom > MIN_ZOOM; layer render refreshes ownership before its early-return gate. Identical ID sets avoid repeated pyramid visibility updates/repaints. Strict > also releases fallback at zoom 14 where source material fade is zero.
findings.verification: Independent rerun passes resident-owner transitions zoom17 -> 14 -> 13 -> 17 and readiness=false. Actual game zoom transition has not been inspected.

boundedChecks.structuredClone: Plain diagnostic snapshot detached from caller; callbacks/nonfinite numbers/prototypes rejected atomically; worker constructs callback plans locally.
boundedChecks.sourceGuards: Exact native ID, footprint, origin and final metadata guards inspected; rejected/expired/duplicate/wrong-ID data preserve stock fallback in tests.
boundedChecks.staleJobs: Generation, current source, transport revision, host-opening revision, look and appearance installation guards inspected; stale transport chunk test passes.
boundedChecks.inlineFallback: Worker failure queues original current source for rebuild; inline and worker use buildTransportedEnvelopeChunk with the same diagnostic options. Actual browser Worker failure was not exercised.
boundedChecks.disableAndFailedLoad: Invalid/empty payload clears owned chunks; failed current fetch clears transport; stale fetch after explicit setter or dispose cannot restore data. Tests pass after repair.
boundedChecks.allLOD: walls/coarse diagnostic roofs tested across photo/storybook/procedural; extras has no independent roof ownership. No gameplay pan or touch review performed.
boundedChecks.independentPyramid: Reason union, late renderer attachment, and release of surveyed reason while retaining landmark reason pass test; zoom/readiness gate transitions pass repaired controller regression.
boundedChecks.result: 8 tests passed, 0 failed after all three root repairs

acceptanceLimits.reason: Tests and transport review do not satisfy the street-rhythm visual acceptance bar. Root retains bundle/GPU ownership and must preserve prior failed source/render evidence.
